title: Pneumatics - Transport of Solids and Separator Types
description: Separators used in pneumatic solids transport systems and their minimum particle size. This tool helps identify the appropriate separator type based on particle size and provides minimum particle size recommendations for different separator principles.

components.content:
## Pneumatic Transport System Overview

In a pneumatic transport system, solids like dust, flour, sugar, sand and many other products, are transported in a high speed air flow.

The table below indicates minimum particle size recommended for different types of separators.

**Conversion Reference:** 1 micron = 0.001 mm

outputs.label: Recommended Separator Types
outputs.formula: inputs.particle_size_micron >= 200 ? 'Gravity' : inputs.particle_size_micron >= 50 ? 'Gravity, Inertial, Centrifugal (large cyclone)' : inputs.particle_size_micron >= 20 ? 'Centrifugal (small cyclone), Inertial' : inputs.particle_size_micron >= 15 ? 'Fan type, Centrifugal (small cyclone)' : inputs.particle_size_micron >= 0.5 ?
